title: The two sovereign ledgers
caption: An engraved plate in five panels drawing the ARCHITECTURE of two ledgers that are never merged. Panel I draws them as two trees with SEPARATE ROOTS in SEPARATE BEDS OF SOIL that do not touch: the UNI CLAIM-LEDGER, rooted in UNI's own gates run on UNI's own artifacts, carrying the 4-value fence, the four ledger states at the ledger's own last recorded snapshot (882 rows), and the A-U evidence classes; and the NATURA NATURE-LEDGER, rooted in third parties publishing in the literature, carrying twelve classes in three groups (measured 578, derived 257, fenced 80 ledger rows) plus four rows drawn DETACHED from every bough because they deliberately carry no class -- reconciling 578 + 257 + 80 + 4 = 919 rows across 23 chapters, 0 out of vocabulary. A double-ruled SOVEREIGN BOUNDARY runs unbroken between them, and the two crowns are joined by a dashed swag marked as an AUDITED CROSS-LINK: a citation, and only a citation, springing crown-to-crown and never root to root. Reference may cross that line; inference may not. Panel II prints the cardinal rule. Panel III is the crosswalk of nine look-alike pairs, where the resemblance is the trap and the load-bearing column is what each can never imply about the other. Panel IV draws TRUE, HONEST and META as three sovereign lanes of EQUAL width -- equal because sovereignty is not proportional to population -- with META marked as carried from outside this corpus. WHAT THE PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM: it does not claim twelve is the final number of NATURA classes (NA-00 declared six and was refuted by 72 of its own 919 rows); it does not claim the 22 un-traced rows are repaired, only correctly labelled; it does not claim the UNI snapshot is current or was recounted here; it prints no per-value count for the 4-value fence, because this corpus publishes none; it does not claim META is an encyclopedia concept; and it raises no UNI rung whatever -- a nature citation is never a UNI gate, the honest program position is unchanged at ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned, and where this plate and a ledger disagree, the ledger wins and the plate is wrong.

not_claimed: Not claimed: that twelve is the correct, exhaustive or final number of NATURA classes. NA-00 declared SIX and was refuted by its own corpus on 72 of its own 919 rows -- which is the strongest available reason not to claim the new number is final. Twelve is what 919 rows MEASURED, not a design target; a thirteenth is a finding, not a failure.

Not claimed: that the 22 un-traced rows (NOT-SOURCED 20 + NOT-CONFIRMED 1 + NOT-LOCATED 1) are repaired. They are now correctly LABELLED, which is a description of a defect, not its repair. Naming a defect precisely is not fixing it, and closing them is real work that has not been done.

Not claimed: that the UNI snapshot (882 rows = 350 PASS / 0 FAIL / 183 NEGATIVE / 349 PENDING) is current, or was recounted for this plate. It is carried as exactly what it is -- the ledger's own last recorded snapshot -- and an upstream prior is never fresh evidence.

Not claimed: any per-value count for the 4-value fence (proven / designed / hypothesized / not-yet-built). This corpus publishes none, and this plate invents none. A plausible-sounding number with no source is the worst defect available here; NOT-MEASURED is written instead. There is no third state.

Not claimed: that META is an encyclopedia concept. It appears in 0 files of this corpus and is carried from the wider UNI Tree doctrine (arca META). Its lane rests on the lexicon's authority alone, and the lexicon discloses this itself -- the plate carries the disclosure rather than inheriting it quietly.

Not claimed: that the three lanes' equal width means equal population, or that any lane outranks another. TRUE 98 / META 31 / HONEST 1 of 130 concepts. The lanes are drawn equal because SOVEREIGNTY IS NOT PROPORTIONAL TO POPULATION: a lane with one row is exactly as sovereign as a lane with 98.

Not claimed: that HONEST is a weaker or unfinished kind of TRUE. Testimony is not a failed measurement; it is a different kind of signal, and forcing it into the TRUE-side vocabulary -- even into an honest-looking fence like NOT-MEASURED -- would be wrong in the direction that flatters the corpus.

Not claimed: that this plate's own count-claims are claims about NATURE. They are claims about the corpus's own files, carded in the CLAIM-LEDGER's A-U taxonomy (Class A where a script counts them, Class F where the ledger's own snapshot is carried forward). NO NATURA CLASS is used for anything this plate itself asserts -- the plate makes no claim about nature at all.

Not claimed: that anything on this plate raises, lowers or discharges any UNI row. The plate draws the ARCHITECTURE of two ledgers. It holds no gate and earns no rung, and the honest program position is unchanged by it: ~2 of 11+ developmental rungs earned; a developmental active-inference SIMULATION; a toy world, never a person.
Not claimed: anything whatever about 'full human' or 'the next evolution beyond human'. Both are QUAESTIO APERTA -- permanent open questions, never targets, never milestones, never deliverables.
Not claimed: that the drawing is evidence of the architecture's correctness. A diagram of a fence is not a fence.
Not claimed: that this plate may stand in for either ledger. It is a drawing. WHERE THE PLATE AND A LEDGER DISAGREE, THE LEDGER WINS AND THE PLATE IS WRONG.

evidence_classes._two_sovereign_vocabularies: This plate DRAWS both vocabularies and MERGES NEITHER. They are never combined, and there is no operation that takes a row of one and a row of the other and produces a stronger row of either kind.
evidence_classes._natura_vocabulary: NATURA classes per encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md, AMENDED 2026-07-15-A: TWELVE classes in three groups (measured / derived / fenced), plus four rows registered as deliberately unclassed. Ledger of record: encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md. Governs NATURE's observed regularities, measured by third parties in published literature. This plate draws all twelve; it asserts none of them ABOUT nature.
evidence_classes._uni_vocabulary: The UNI 4-value fence (proven / designed / hypothesized / not-yet-built) and the four ledger states (PASS / FAIL / NEGATIVE / PENDING), governed by encyclopedia/CLAIM-LEDGER.md. Governs UNI's own build status over UNI's own artifacts.
evidence_classes._this_plates_own_claims: READ THIS BEFORE READING claims[]. The claims this plate makes are about THE CORPUS'S OWN FILES (how many rows a ledger carries, what a chapter says), not about nature. A NATURA class is therefore NOT used for any of them -- doing so would be the exact lane-crossing the plate exists to forbid. They are carded in the CLAIM-LEDGER's own A-U taxonomy, which governs claims about UNI's own artifacts (and the ledger files are UNI's own artifacts): 'A' = machine-exact anchor -- a script counts it exactly and the receipt is named; 'B' = mechanism + operator observation -- e.g. a grep reproduced for this plate, with a positive control on the instrument; 'F' = doc / prior-claim, inheritable but MUST BE RE-VERIFIED -- used where the corpus's own recorded figure is carried forward without a recount, and marked as such on the plate's face; 'method' = a definitional / governance pattern, not an empirical claim. NO CLASS HERE RAISES ANY RUNG. Counting rows is not a capability, and a Class-A count of a file says nothing whatever about what UNI can do.
evidence_classes._counting_asymmetry: The two sides of the plate are counted TO DIFFERENT STANDARDS, and the plate draws the asymmetry rather than smoothing it. NATURA side: machine-counted, and the verifier was re-run for this plate (Class A). UNI side: the ledger's own last recorded snapshot, NOT recounted (Class F). For the 4-value fence there is NO published per-value count, so the plate prints none.

_natura_classes_drawn_but_not_asserted._note: Drawn as the right-hand tree's boughs. The plate reports HOW MANY rows carry each class; it makes no claim about nature under any of them.

_plate_marks.=: SOVEREIGN BOUNDARY - separates two vocabularies. Reference may cross it; INFERENCE MAY NOT. Drawn unbroken: a gap would read as the boundary opening.
_plate_marks.--: AUDITED CROSS-LINK - a citation, and only a citation. Drawn crown-to-crown, never root to root.
_plate_marks.X: MERGE - forbidden, the cardinal sin. Never drawn as a legal operation anywhere on this plate.
_plate_marks.triangle: GROUP B / DERIVED - the assumptions are the fence
_plate_marks.lozenge: GROUP C / FENCED - the row carries no usable value, and the class says why not
_plate_marks.circled-dot: REGISTERED 2026-07-15 - one of the six classes added when the six-class design was refuted
_plate_marks.square: CARRIED, NOT CLASSED - a closed list of four, not an open category
_plate_marks._greyscale: Line weight, dash pattern and hatch carry every distinction colour carries; the plate is designed to survive greyscale printing.

falsifiers_of_this_plate: Any count on the plate that tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py does not reproduce exactly.
Any quoted sentence that is not in its cited source, at that wording.
A merge drawn as legal: any line on this plate that lets a NATURA row raise, lower or discharge a UNI row, or the reverse.
A number on the plate with no source, no units or no scope.
The plate disagreeing with either ledger -- in which case THE LEDGER WINS AND THE PLATE IS WRONG.
design_fence: DESIGN-ONLY: no script elements, no event handlers, no external references (no xlink to a URL, no @import, no webfont, no remote image). Pure static SVG, viewBox-based and responsive, renders standalone and inline, and is legible in both light and dark via CSS variables with fallbacks. No secrets, tokens, keys or private endpoints.
